name: singlet_demux_species_of_origin_assignment
title: Species-of-origin assignment of barcodes and read pairs
description: Assigns each barcode of a two-species library (xenograft or barnyard) to species A, species B, mixed or ambiguous from genome-specific UMI counts, with a posterior for the mixed class. Use the default mixture method for barcode labels. Use disambiguate or xenocell only when read-level inputs are available. Do not use on single-species data, where it would invent a second species.

dataset.description: Dataset handle with per-genome layers/counts and var/genome: a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle.

genome_a_label.description: Value of var/genome for the first genome, for example human. The other genome is species B.

method.description: Barcode mixture model (default) or a comparator rule; xenocell and disambiguate are read-level.

min_umis_per_barcode.description: Barcodes with fewer genome-specific UMIs are reported as ambiguous.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for EM initialisation (mixture) and bootstraps (cellranger_style).

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without writing members.

overwrite.description: Replace existing species members instead of failing.

mixture.description: Options for the barcode mixture model.

tolerance.description: Stop when the log-likelihood change falls below this value.

cellranger_style.description: Options for the Cell Ranger comparator; guard values fixed as in its source.

n_bootstrap.description: Bootstrap samples for the multiplet estimator.

xenocell.description: Options for the XenoCell comparator; needs read-level input.

fastq_in.description: Paired FASTQ input to Xenome classification (path or URI).

xenome_index.description: Xenome index prefix built for both genomes.

xenome_k.description: k-mer length of the Xenome index.

host_fraction_lower.description: Inclusive lower bound of the host-fraction window.

host_fraction_upper.description: Inclusive upper bound of the host-fraction window.

disambiguate.description: Options for the disambiguate comparator; needs read-level input.

bam_genome_a.description: Name-sorted BAM aligned to genome A.

bam_genome_b.description: Name-sorted BAM aligned to genome B.

tag_order.description: AS_NM for BWA and STAR alignments; XO_NM_NH for TopHat-style tags.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was, or would be, updated.

status.description: completed: members written inline; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/species_call. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Method, class_counts (A, B, mixed, ambiguous, empty), mu and converged for completed calls.

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
